rationale: The agent failed to obtain explicit confirmation from the user before processing the return of the skateboards, as the user expressed their desire to return additional items but did not confirm the return for the skateboards specifically when the first confirmation was asked. According to the policy, explicit user confirmation is mandatory before performing any changes related to orders. Although the agent successfully authenticated the user, identified the appropriate items for return, and processed the requests accurately afterward, the initial confirmation step was missed, which ultimately leads to a fail verdict.
